name: Expanding targets and forced disocclusion
summary: Targets under the pointer grow in size and occluding objects are pushed aside, making small and hidden targets easier to select.
howItWorks: The object nearest the pointer is enlarged in screen space, and objects that hide it are moved out of the line of sight until the selection is confirmed.
